strategies.name: fair value gap retest
strategies.rules: Gap: bar 1 high below bar 3 low (bullish) or bar 1 low above bar 3 high (bearish), at least 2 ticks, unfilled. Entry: the first bar that trades into the gap and closes in its direction; market order at the next open. Stop: 1 tick beyond the far side of the gap. Target: the R multiple of the portfolio. Flat by 16:55 New York.
strategies.common_rules: All strategies: entries are market orders at the next bar open, checked after costs; a signal with risk under 6 or over 60 index points is skipped; positions are flat by 16:55 New York, before the CME daily break; one position per portfolio.
strategies.target: 2R or 1.5R or 3R (a multiple of the risk to the stop)
strategies.exit: At the stop, at the target, or flat by 16:55 New York, whichever comes first.
strategies.data: Yahoo MNQ=F 1-minute bars built into 5-minute bars (DELAYED public data). Paper only.

strategies.name: liquidity sweep then market structure shift
strategies.description: liquidity sweep then market structure shift
strategies.rules: Long: within the last 12 bars a bar traded below the last confirmed swing low (the sweep); now, for the first time since, a bar closes above the last confirmed swing high before the sweep (the shift). Short: mirror. Stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme.
strategies.common_rules: All strategies: entries are market orders at the next bar open, checked after costs; a signal with risk under 6 or over 60 index points is skipped; positions are flat by 16:55 New York, before the CME daily break; one position per portfolio.

strategies.name: liquidity sweep and reclaim
strategies.rules: Long: the bar trades below the last confirmed swing low, closes back above it and above the prior bar high. Short: mirror at the last swing high. Stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme.

strategies.rules: Long: the first bar of the CME day to trade below the previous day low and close back above it. Short: mirror at the previous day high. Stop 1 tick beyond the bar extreme.

strategies.name: order block retest
strategies.rules: A displacement bar (body at least 1.5 ATR). Long: the last down bar before an up displacement is the block; the next bar trades into it and closes up. Short: mirror. Stop 1 tick beyond the block.
strategies.common_rules: All strategies: entries are market orders at the next bar open, checked after costs; a signal with risk under 6 or over 60 index points is skipped; positions are flat by 16:55 New York, before the CME daily break; one position per portfolio.

strategies.name: opening range breakout (9:30–9:45 New York)
strategies.rules: Range: high and low of 9:30–9:45 New York. Entry: the first 5-minute close above the high (long) or below the low (short) between 9:45 and 11:30. Stop: the middle of the range. Target: the R multiple of the portfolio. Flat by 15:55 New York.

strategies.name: VWAP 2-sigma reversion
strategies.rules: Session VWAP from 18:00 New York. Long: a close below VWAP minus 2 standard deviations, then a close back inside on an up bar. Short: mirror. Stop 1 tick beyond the two-bar extreme. Target: VWAP.
strategies.common_rules: All strategies: entries are market orders at the next bar open, checked after costs; a signal with risk under 6 or over 60 index points is skipped; positions are flat by 16:55 New York, before the CME daily break; one position per portfolio.
